hint.pipe_timeout: The DLL was injected but the SDK never opened its pipe, so it failed while starting. Make sure the DLL matches this client build (3.3.5a, 12340) and check the Processes tab for games left open by earlier attempts.
hint.game_closed: The game closed while the SDK was starting. It probably crashed: look for a new file in the game's Errors folder.
hint.load_library: Windows could not load the DLL. Check its path, that it is the 32-bit build and that the Visual C++ x86 runtime is installed.
hint.create_process: Wow.exe could not be started. Check its path and that no security software blocks it.
hint.auth_rejected: The SDK pipe already had a session configured. Another game with the SDK is probably running: close it in the Processes tab and try again.
hint.auth_unavailable: The SDK opened its pipe but stopped answering while the session was configured.
hint.token: The session token was not valid.
hint.hidden: The SDK could not prepare the hidden start.
hint.unknown: Check the Activity tab for the injector output.
processes.empty: No Wow.exe or WowInjector.exe is running.
